decisions.reason: Here "much more" says not only that grace is more certain but that it is greater: it outweighs and overflows what the trespass did (verse 20).

decisions.choice: the trespass and the free gift are not alike
decisions.reason: Balanced turns the compressed Greek ("not as the trespass, so also the free gift") into a plain statement.

decisions.choice: Adam's sin; one man sinned
decisions.reason: Readable says "sin" for "trespass", a word young readers may not know, and names Adam, the one man of verses 12-14.

decisions.choice: transgresión
decisions.reason: The word 11:11-12 uses for the same Greek noun, a false step. It is kept through verses 15-20 and kept apart from "infracción" in verse 14.

decisions.choice: el don gratuito; el don (L, B); el regalo (R)
decisions.reason: "Don gratuito" for the gift given out of grace (the meaning decision), "don" for the plainer word beside it. Readable says "regalo" for both, the everyday word, as 3:24 does.

decisions.choice: los muchos
decisions.reason: Kept with its article at Literal and Balanced, as in the English: "the many" means all who belong to each one (meaning decision), not merely a large number. Readable says "muchas personas".

decisions.choice: kosa
decisions.reason: The word 11:11-12 uses for the same Greek noun. It is kept through verses 15-20; verse 14 uses "ukiukaji" for a different word.

decisions.choice: karama ya bure; zawadi (L, B); zawadi (R)
decisions.reason: "Karama" (as 1:11) is a gift given out of grace; "ya bure" says it is free, as the English "free gift". The plainer word beside it is "zawadi". Readable says "zawadi" for both.

decisions.choice: wale wengi
decisions.reason: "Wale" keeps the article of "the many" at Literal and Balanced, as in the English: all who belong to each one (meaning decision). Readable says "watu wengi".

decisions.choice: "la faute" for the trespass (verses 15-20)
decisions.reason: "Faute" is the common French word for a wrong act. "Transgression" is kept for the breaking of a stated command in verse 14, a different Greek word; "offense" today suggests an insult.

decisions.choice: "la multitude" for "the many"
decisions.reason: French cannot say "les nombreux". "La multitude" keeps the article and the contrast with "un seul", and, like the Greek, speaks of a whole great number, as the meaning decision explains. Readable says "beaucoup de gens".

decisions.choice: "ân tứ" for the free gift (L, B), "món quà" for the other word for gift; "món quà" (R) for both
decisions.reason: "Ân tứ" is a gift given out of grace (m2), the word used in 1:11 for the same Greek noun, and keeps its link with "ân điển". The plainer word beside it is "món quà". Readable says "món quà" for both.

decisions.choice: "số đông" (L, B); "nhiều người" (R) for "the many" (also verse 19)
decisions.reason: The Greek has the article: "the many", all who belong to the one man (m3). "Số đông" names a whole great number as one body, which "nhiều người" (many people) does not. Readable says "nhiều người".

decisions.choice: "범죄" (L, B) / "죄" (R) for the trespass, verses 15-20; "은사" (L) / "은혜의 선물" (B) / "하나님의 선물" (R) for the free gift
decisions.reason: "범죄" is the word used for this noun in 4:25 and in the Korean of Colossians 2:13, a specific wrong act; Readable says "죄", as the English Readable says "sin". The gift is one that comes from grace (meaning decision), which Balanced says in so many words, as "은사" does in Literal.

decisions.choice: "많은 사람" for "the many"
decisions.reason: Korean cannot keep the article, but "많은 사람" set against "한 사람" keeps the contrast the Greek draws, and verse 18 says "모든 사람", so the reader can see, as the meaning decision explains, that the many are all.

source.text: καὶ οὐχ ὡς δι’ ἑνὸς ἁμαρτήσαντος τὸ δώρημα· τὸ μὲν γὰρ κρίμα ἐξ ἑνὸς εἰς κατάκριμα, τὸ δὲ χάρισμα ἐκ πολλῶν παραπτωμάτων εἰς δικαίωμα.

records.literal_gloss: And not as through one having sinned the gift; the indeed for judgment [was] from one to condemnation, the but free gift from many trespasses to justification.

en.L: And the gift [is] not as [what came] through one who sinned; for the judgment [came] from one [trespass] to condemnation, but the free gift from many trespasses to justification.
en.B: Nor is the gift like what came through the one man who sinned. The judgment followed one trespass and brought condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses and brought acquittal.
en.R: And God's gift does not work like what happened because of that one man's sin. After one sin came God's judgment, and it meant condemnation. But God's free gift came after many sins, and it puts people right with God.

es.L: Y el don no [es] como [lo que vino] por medio de uno que pecó; porque el juicio [vino] de una sola [transgresión] para condenación, pero el don gratuito, de muchas transgresiones para justificación.
es.B: Tampoco el don es como lo que vino por medio del único hombre que pecó. El juicio siguió a una sola transgresión y trajo condenación, pero el don gratuito siguió a muchas transgresiones y trajo absolución.
es.R: Y el regalo de Dios no funciona como lo que pasó por el pecado de aquel hombre. Después de un solo pecado vino el juicio de Dios, y significó condenación. Pero el regalo de Dios vino después de muchos pecados, y declara justas a las personas.

sw.L: Na zawadi [haiko] kama [kile kilichokuja] kupitia mmoja aliyetenda dhambi; kwa maana hukumu [ilitoka] kwa [kosa] moja hadi adhabu, lakini karama ya bure [ilitoka] kwa makosa mengi hadi kuhesabiwa haki.
sw.B: Wala zawadi hiyo si kama kile kilichokuja kupitia yule mtu mmoja aliyetenda dhambi. Hukumu ilifuata kosa moja ikaleta adhabu, lakini karama ya bure ilifuata makosa mengi ikaleta kutangazwa bila hatia.
sw.R: Tena zawadi ya Mungu haifanyi kazi kama yale yaliyotokea kwa sababu ya dhambi ya mtu yule mmoja. Baada ya dhambi moja ilikuja hukumu ya Mungu, nayo ilimaanisha adhabu. Lakini zawadi ya Mungu ilikuja baada ya dhambi nyingi, nayo inawafanya watu wahesabiwe haki.

fr.L: Et il n’en va pas du don comme de ce qui [est venu] par un seul qui a péché ; car le jugement [est venu] d’une seule [faute] pour la condamnation, mais le don gratuit, de nombreuses fautes pour la justification.
fr.B: Le don n’est pas non plus comme ce qui est venu par l’unique homme qui a péché. Le jugement a suivi une seule faute et a apporté la condamnation, mais le don gratuit a suivi de nombreuses fautes et a apporté l’acquittement.
fr.R: Et le don de Dieu n’agit pas comme ce qui est arrivé à cause du péché de cet homme. Après un seul péché est venu le jugement de Dieu, et il a apporté la condamnation. Mais le don gratuit de Dieu est venu après beaucoup de péchés, et il rend les gens justes aux yeux de Dieu.

vi.L: Và món quà không giống như [điều đã đến] qua một người đã phạm tội; vì sự phán xét [đến] từ một [sự vi phạm] dẫn đến sự kết án, nhưng ân tứ [đến] từ nhiều sự vi phạm dẫn đến sự xưng công chính.
vi.B: Món quà ấy cũng không giống như điều đã đến qua một người phạm tội. Sự phán xét đến sau một sự vi phạm và đem lại sự kết án, còn ân tứ đến sau nhiều sự vi phạm và đem lại sự xưng công chính.
vi.R: Món quà của Đức Chúa Trời không giống như điều đã xảy ra vì tội của một người ấy. Sau một tội là sự phán xét của Đức Chúa Trời, và điều đó có nghĩa là bị kết án. Nhưng món quà nhưng không của Đức Chúa Trời đến sau rất nhiều tội lỗi, và món quà ấy làm cho con người được Đức Chúa Trời công nhận là công chính.

ko.L: 또 그 선물은 죄를 지은 한 사람을 통하여 [온 것과] 같지 않습니다. 심판은 한 [범죄]에서 정죄에 이르렀지만, 은사는 많은 범죄들에서 의롭다는 판결에 이르렀습니다.
ko.B: 또 그 선물은 죄를 지은 한 사람을 통해 온 것과 같지 않습니다. 심판은 한 번의 범죄 뒤에 와서 정죄를 가져왔지만, 은혜의 선물은 많은 범죄 뒤에 와서 무죄 판결을 가져왔습니다.
ko.R: 또 하나님의 선물은 그 한 사람의 죄 때문에 일어난 일과 다릅니다. 한 번의 죄 뒤에 하나님의 심판이 왔고, 그것은 유죄 판결이었습니다. 그러나 하나님의 선물은 수많은 죄 뒤에 왔고, 그 선물은 사람들을 의롭다고 인정해 줍니다.

decisions.choice: from one: from one trespass
decisions.reason: "From one" is most likely one trespass, set against "many trespasses" later in the verse. It could also be one man, as in the first half of the verse.

decisions.choice: justification: the verdict that declares righteous
decisions.reason: dikaiōma usually means a righteous requirement (1:32, 2:26, 8:4) or a righteous act (verse 18). Here it stands opposite "condemnation", so it is the opposite verdict: acquittal, being declared righteous.

decisions.choice: judgment and condemnation: a verdict and its sentence
decisions.reason: krima is the judge's decision; katakrima is the sentence of condemnation that follows (8:1).

decisions.choice: from many trespasses: grace answers all the sins that followed
decisions.reason: The judgment answered a single act; the gift answers the many sins of all people after it. That is the second way the gift is greater.

decisions.choice: acquittal
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the court word opposite "condemnation". Readable says "puts people right with God", as for "justify".

decisions.choice: God's judgment
decisions.reason: Readable says whose judgment it was.

decisions.choice: absolución
decisions.reason: Balanced follows the English "acquittal": the verdict that clears the accused, set against "condenación". Literal keeps "justificación"; verse 18 uses "justificación" for a related noun.

decisions.choice: declara justas a las personas
decisions.reason: As at 3:24, Spanish Readable says "declarar justo" where the English Readable says "puts people right with God".

decisions.choice: kutangazwa bila hatia
decisions.reason: Balanced follows the English "acquittal": being declared not guilty, set against "adhabu". Literal keeps "kuhesabiwa haki".

decisions.choice: hukumu; adhabu
decisions.reason: "Hukumu" is the judgment, "adhabu" the condemnation it brings, the verdict and its sentence that the meaning decision describes. The same "adhabu" stands in verse 18.

decisions.choice: "sự xưng công chính" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The word is the verdict that declares righteous (m2), the opposite of condemnation. The English Balanced says "acquittal"; Vietnamese keeps the family of "xưng công chính" settled at 2:13, which already says a verdict, so the link with the rest of the letter stays.

decisions.choice: "의롭다는 판결" (L); "무죄 판결" (B); "의롭다고 인정해 줍니다" (R)
decisions.reason: Here the noun stands opposite "condemnation" and means the opposite verdict (meaning decision). Literal keeps the root "의"; Balanced uses the court word, as the English says "acquittal"; Readable uses the verb settled at 2:13.

source.text: εἰ γὰρ τῷ τοῦ ἑνὸς παραπτώματι ὁ θάνατος ἐβασίλευσεν διὰ τοῦ ἑνός, πολλῷ μᾶλλον οἱ τὴν περισσείαν τῆς χάριτος καὶ τῆς δωρεᾶς τῆς δικαιοσύνης λαμβάνοντες ἐν ζωῇ βασιλεύσουσιν διὰ τοῦ ἑνὸς Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: If for by the of the one trespass the death reigned through the one, by much more the [ones] the abundance of the grace and of the gift of the righteousness receiving in life will reign through the one Jesus Christ.

en.L: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one, much more those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness will reign in life through the one, Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: If death reigned through one man because of that one man's trespass, it is far more certain that those who receive grace in full measure and the gift of righteousness will reign in life through the one man Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: One man sinned, and because of that, death ruled as king through that one man. But God gives grace in rich measure, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gives righteousness as a gift. So it is even more certain that those who receive this will live and rule as kings through one man, Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.

es.L: Porque si por la transgresión del uno la muerte reinó por medio de ese uno, mucho más los que reciben la gracia desbordante y el don de la justicia reinarán en vida por medio del único, {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.
es.B: Si la muerte reinó por medio de un solo hombre a causa de la transgresión de ese hombre, es mucho más seguro que los que reciben gracia en plena medida y el don de la justicia reinarán en vida por medio del único hombre, {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.
es.R: Un solo hombre pecó, y por eso la muerte gobernó como rey por medio de ese hombre. Pero Dios da gracia en abundancia, y da la justicia como un regalo. Así que es todavía más seguro que los que reciben esto vivirán y gobernarán como reyes por medio de un solo hombre, {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana ikiwa kwa kosa la yule mmoja kifo kilitawala kupitia yule mmoja, zaidi sana wale wanaopokea neema kwa wingi na zawadi ya haki watatawala katika uzima kupitia yule mmoja, Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Ikiwa kifo kilitawala kupitia mtu mmoja kwa sababu ya kosa la mtu huyo mmoja, ni hakika zaidi sana kwamba wale wanaopokea neema kwa kipimo kamili na zawadi ya haki watatawala katika uzima kupitia mtu yule mmoja, Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.R: Mtu mmoja alitenda dhambi, na kwa sababu hiyo kifo kilitawala kama mfalme kupitia mtu huyo mmoja. Lakini Mungu anatoa neema kwa wingi, tena anatoa haki kama zawadi. Kwa hiyo ni hakika zaidi kwamba wale wanaopokea hayo wataishi na kutawala kama wafalme kupitia mtu mmoja, Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.

fr.L: Car si, par la faute d’un seul, la mort a régné par ce seul [homme], à bien plus forte raison ceux qui reçoivent l’abondance de la grâce et du don de la justice régneront-ils dans la vie par le seul Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.B: Si la mort a régné par un seul homme à cause de la faute de ce seul homme, il est bien plus certain encore que ceux qui reçoivent la grâce en abondance et le don de la justice régneront dans la vie par un seul homme, Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}.
fr.R: Un seul homme a péché, et à cause de cela, la mort a régné comme un roi par cet homme. Mais Dieu donne la grâce en abondance, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} donne la justice comme un cadeau. Alors il est encore plus certain que ceux qui reçoivent cela vivront et régneront comme des rois par un seul homme, Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}.

vi.L: Vì nếu bởi sự vi phạm của một người mà sự chết đã cai trị qua một người ấy, thì huống chi những người nhận ân điển dư dật và món quà của sự công chính sẽ cai trị trong sự sống qua một người là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.
vi.B: Nếu sự chết đã cai trị qua một người vì sự vi phạm của một người ấy, thì chắc chắn hơn biết bao, những ai nhận ân điển dồi dào và món quà là sự công chính sẽ cai trị trong sự sống qua một người là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: Một người đã phạm tội, và vì điều đó, sự chết đã cai trị như một vua qua người ấy. Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời ban ân điển thật dồi dào, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban sự công chính như một món quà. Vì vậy càng chắc chắn hơn nữa là những ai nhận lấy những điều này sẽ được sống và cai trị như vua qua một người, là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.

ko.L: 한 사람의 범죄로 죽음이 그 한 사람을 통하여 왕 노릇 했다면, 더욱더 은혜와 의의 선물을 넘치도록 받는 사람들은 한 분 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통하여 생명 안에서 왕 노릇 할 것입니다.
ko.B: 한 사람의 범죄 때문에 그 한 사람을 통해 죽음이 왕처럼 다스렸다면, 넘치는 은혜와 의의 선물을 받는 사람들이 한 분 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통해 생명 안에서 왕처럼 다스릴 것은 더욱 확실합니다.
ko.R: 한 사람이 죄를 지었고, 그 때문에 그 한 사람을 통해 죽음이 왕처럼 다스렸습니다. 그러나 하나님께서는 은혜를 넘치도록 주시고, 의를 선물로 주십니다. 그러니 이것을 받는 사람들이 한 분, 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통해 생명을 누리며 왕처럼 다스리게 될 것은 더욱 확실합니다.

decisions.choice: those who receive will reign: not life reigning, but people
decisions.reason: Paul does not say "life will reign", as the parallel with death would lead one to expect, but that people will reign in life. Those once ruled by death will themselves share Christ's rule (8:17, 2 Timothy 2:12). The future looks to the age to come, though the present participle "receiving" includes receiving now.

decisions.choice: the gift of righteousness: righteousness given as a gift
decisions.reason: The genitive tells what the gift is: righteousness, the right standing with God that he gives (3:21-22, 4:5).

decisions.choice: abundance: overflowing measure
decisions.reason: perisseia is a superabundance, more than enough; it echoes "overflowed" in verse 15.

decisions.choice: the sentence broken into three
decisions.reason: Readable states the two sides of the comparison in separate sentences and turns "those who receive the abundance of grace" into what God gives.

decisions.choice: ruled as king; live and rule as kings
decisions.reason: Readable says what "reign" means and turns "in life" into a verb, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: neema kwa wingi
decisions.reason: "Wingi wa neema" would copy the Greek noun but reads stiffly; "neema kwa wingi" (grace in abundance) keeps the sense of overflowing measure (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "한 사람" for Adam, "한 분" with the honorific for Jesus Christ
decisions.reason: The Greek says "the one" of both. Korean must choose a form for a person, and the honorific "분" for Jesus, as the Korean style guide gives, while Adam takes the plain "사람". The contrast of the one and the many is kept.

source.text: Ἄρα οὖν ὡς δι’ ἑνὸς παραπτώματος εἰς πάντας ἀνθρώπους εἰς κατάκριμα, οὕτως καὶ δι’ ἑνὸς δικαιώματος εἰς πάντας ἀνθρώπους εἰς δικαίωσιν ζωῆς·

records.literal_gloss: So then, as through one trespass to all men to condemnation, so also through one righteous act to all men to justification of life;

en.L: So then, as through one trespass [the result was] condemnation for all {{gender:people|men}}, so also through one righteous act [the result is] justification of life for all {{gender:people|men}}.
en.B: So then, as one trespass meant condemnation for all {{gender:people|men}}, so one righteous act means for all {{gender:people|men}} that they are declared righteous and given life.
en.R: So one sin brought condemnation on everyone. In the same way, one right action leads to people being made right with God and having life, and this is for everyone.

es.L: Así que, como por medio de una sola transgresión [el resultado fue] condenación para {{gender:todas las personas|todos los hombres}}, así también por medio de un solo acto de justicia [el resultado es] justificación de vida para {{gender:todas las personas|todos los hombres}}.
es.B: Así pues, como una sola transgresión significó condenación para {{gender:todas las personas|todos los hombres}}, así un solo acto justo trae a {{gender:todas las personas|todos los hombres}} la justificación que da vida.
es.R: Así que un solo pecado trajo condenación sobre todos. De la misma manera, una sola acción justa hace que las personas sean declaradas justas y tengan vida, y esto es para todos.

sw.L: Basi hivyo, kama kupitia kosa moja [matokeo yalikuwa] adhabu kwa watu wote, vivyo hivyo kupitia tendo moja la haki [matokeo ni] kuhesabiwa haki kwa uzima kwa watu wote.
sw.B: Basi, kama kosa moja lilileta adhabu kwa watu wote, vivyo hivyo tendo moja la haki linaleta kwa watu wote kuhesabiwa haki na kupewa uzima.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo dhambi moja ilileta adhabu juu ya kila mtu. Vivyo hivyo, tendo moja la haki linawawezesha watu kuhesabiwa haki na kuwa na uzima, na jambo hili ni kwa ajili ya kila mtu.

fr.L: Ainsi donc, comme par une seule faute [il en est résulté] la condamnation pour {{gender:tous les êtres humains|tous les hommes}}, de même aussi par un seul acte de justice [il en résulte] pour {{gender:tous les êtres humains|tous les hommes}} la justification de vie.
fr.B: Ainsi donc, comme une seule faute a valu la condamnation à {{gender:tous les êtres humains|tous les hommes}}, de même un seul acte juste vaut à {{gender:tous les êtres humains|tous les hommes}} d’être déclarés justes et de recevoir la vie.
fr.R: Un seul péché a donc apporté la condamnation sur tout le monde. De la même façon, une seule action juste permet aux gens d’être rendus justes aux yeux de Dieu et d’avoir la vie, et cela, c’est pour tout le monde.

vi.L: Vậy thì, như bởi một sự vi phạm mà [kết quả là] sự kết án cho mọi người, thì cũng vậy, bởi một hành động công chính mà [kết quả là] sự xưng công chính đem lại sự sống cho mọi người.
vi.B: Vậy, như một sự vi phạm đã đem sự kết án đến cho mọi người, thì một hành động công chính cũng đem đến cho mọi người sự xưng công chính và sự sống.
vi.R: Vậy một tội đã đem sự kết án đến cho mọi người. Cũng thế, một hành động công chính đem lại cho mọi người việc được Đức Chúa Trời công nhận là công chính và có sự sống.

ko.L: 그러므로 한 범죄를 통하여 모든 사람에게 정죄가 [이르렀던] 것처럼, 한 의로운 행위를 통하여 모든 사람에게 생명에 이르는 의롭다는 판결이 [이릅니다].
ko.B: 그러므로 한 번의 범죄가 모든 사람에게 정죄를 가져왔듯이, 한 번의 의로운 행위는 모든 사람이 의롭다고 인정받고 생명을 얻게 합니다.
ko.R: 그래서 한 번의 죄가 모든 사람에게 유죄 판결을 가져왔습니다. 마찬가지로, 한 번의 올바른 행동이 사람들을 의롭다고 인정받고 생명을 얻게 합니다. 그리고 이것은 모든 사람을 위한 것입니다.

decisions.choice: the comparison begun in verse 12 is completed
decisions.reason: "As ... so also" picks up the "just as" of verse 12 and finishes it. The sentence has no verbs; the sense is supplied from verses 16-17.

decisions.choice: one trespass, one righteous act
alternatives: the trespass of one man; the righteous act of one man
decisions.reason: "One" agrees with the nouns, so the Greek most naturally means "one trespass" and "one righteous act", not "one man's". The one righteous act is Christ's obedience, above all in his death (verse 19, Philippians 2:8).

decisions.choice: justification of life: being declared righteous, which brings life
decisions.reason: dikaiōsis is the act of declaring righteous (4:25). "Of life" says what it leads to: the life of verse 17 and eternal life (verse 21).

decisions.choice: for all people: the gift as wide as the fall
alternatives: every person without exception will be declared righteous
decisions.reason: As Adam's trespass affected all, Christ's act is for all, with no one outside its reach. Verse 17 has said the reign in life belongs to "those who receive" the gift; Paul does not here explain how the two are related. The translation keeps "all" at every level.

decisions.choice: the result was (L); meant (B)
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb. Literal brackets the words it needs; Balanced uses "meant" and "means" to keep the past act and the present result.

decisions.choice: one right action; made right with God
decisions.reason: Readable says "right action" for the righteous act and "made right with God" for justification, as in verse 1.

decisions.choice: {{gender:todas las personas|todos los hombres}}
decisions.reason: As in verse 12: Spanish follows the English setting, with "todas las personas" as the default. Balanced is worded so that nothing outside the span has to agree with it.

decisions.choice: un solo acto de justicia (L); un solo acto justo (B)
decisions.reason: The same noun that verse 16 renders "absolución" (Balanced) here means a righteous deed, set against the one trespass (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: watu wote, no setting
decisions.reason: As in verse 12: "watu" already includes women and men.

decisions.choice: {{gender:tous les êtres humains|tous les hommes}} (L, B); "tout le monde" (R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 12: "tous les hommes" in French is read more and more as men only, so the default says "all human beings"; Readable says "tout le monde", which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: "một hành động công chính" at every level
decisions.reason: The Greek word is from the righteousness family and here means Christ's one righteous act (m2). "Hành động công chính" keeps "công chính" and stays plain enough for Readable, which the English Readable puts as "one right action".

decisions.choice: "모든 사람" with no gender span at every level
decisions.reason: Where the English has {{gender:people|men}}, Korean "모든 사람" already means all human beings, men and women, so the setting has nothing to change. "모든" is kept at every level, as the meaning decision asks.

source.text: ὥσπερ γὰρ διὰ τῆς παρακοῆς τοῦ ἑνὸς ἀνθρώπου ἁμαρτωλοὶ κατεστάθησαν οἱ πολλοί, οὕτως καὶ διὰ τῆς ὑπακοῆς τοῦ ἑνὸς δίκαιοι κατασταθήσονται οἱ πολλοί.

records.literal_gloss: Just as for through the disobedience of the one man sinners were made the many, so also through the obedience of the one righteous will be made the many.

en.L: For just as through the disobedience of the one man the many were constituted sinners, so also through the obedience of the one the many will be constituted righteous.
en.B: For the disobedience of one man made the many sinners, and in the same way the obedience of the one will make the many righteous.
en.R: Because one man disobeyed God, many people became sinners. In the same way, because one man obeyed God, many people will be made righteous.

es.L: Porque tal como, por la desobediencia de aquel único hombre, los muchos quedaron establecidos como pecadores, así también, por la obediencia del único, los muchos quedarán establecidos como justos.
es.B: Porque la desobediencia de un solo hombre hizo pecadores a los muchos, y de la misma manera la obediencia del único hará justos a los muchos.
es.R: Porque un solo hombre desobedeció a Dios, muchas personas llegaron a ser pecadoras. De la misma manera, porque un solo hombre obedeció a Dios, muchas personas llegarán a ser justas.

sw.L: Kwa maana kama vile kupitia kutotii kwa mtu yule mmoja wale wengi waliwekwa kuwa wenye dhambi, vivyo hivyo kupitia utii wa yule mmoja wale wengi watawekwa kuwa wenye haki.
sw.B: Kwa maana kutotii kwa mtu mmoja kuliwafanya wale wengi kuwa wenye dhambi, na vivyo hivyo utii wa yule mmoja utawafanya wale wengi kuwa wenye haki.
sw.R: Kwa sababu mtu mmoja hakumtii Mungu, watu wengi wakawa wenye dhambi. Vivyo hivyo, kwa sababu mtu mmoja alimtii Mungu, watu wengi watafanywa kuwa wenye haki.

fr.L: Car, de même que par la désobéissance d’un seul homme la multitude a été constituée pécheresse, de même aussi par l’obéissance d’un seul la multitude sera constituée juste.
fr.B: Car la désobéissance d’un seul homme a fait de la multitude des pécheurs, et de la même manière l’obéissance d’un seul fera de la multitude des justes.
fr.R: Parce qu’un seul homme a désobéi à Dieu, beaucoup de gens sont devenus pécheurs. De la même façon, parce qu’un seul homme a obéi à Dieu, beaucoup de gens seront rendus justes.

vi.L: Vì như bởi sự không vâng phục của một người mà số đông bị lập làm tội nhân, thì cũng vậy, bởi sự vâng phục của một người mà số đông sẽ được lập làm người công chính.
vi.B: Vì sự không vâng phục của một người đã làm cho số đông trở thành tội nhân, thì cũng vậy, sự vâng phục của một người sẽ làm cho số đông trở thành người công chính.
vi.R: Vì một người đã không vâng lời Đức Chúa Trời, nhiều người đã trở thành tội nhân. Cũng thế, vì một người đã vâng lời Đức Chúa Trời, nhiều người sẽ được làm cho công chính.

ko.L: 한 사람의 불순종을 통하여 많은 사람이 죄인으로 세워진 것처럼, 한 분의 순종을 통하여 많은 사람이 의로운 사람으로 세워질 것입니다.
ko.B: 한 사람의 불순종이 많은 사람을 죄인의 자리에 서게 했듯이, 한 분의 순종이 많은 사람을 의로운 사람의 자리에 서게 할 것입니다.
ko.R: 한 사람이 하나님께 순종하지 않아서 많은 사람이 죄인이 되었습니다. 마찬가지로 한 분이 하나님께 순종하셔서 많은 사람이 의로운 사람으로 인정받게 될 것입니다.

decisions.choice: made: appointed, set in a standing
decisions.reason: kathistēmi is to appoint or put someone in a position (Acts 7:10, Titus 1:5). Through Adam the many were put in the standing of sinners; through Christ they will be put in the standing of the righteous. The word speaks of standing before God, and the next chapters show it also changes how they live.

decisions.choice: will be made: the future of God's final verdict and of all believers to come
alternatives: a logical future: will, as a consequence
decisions.reason: The future can point to the last judgment, when the verdict already given is confirmed, or to all who will yet believe. Both fit; Paul uses the future in the same way in verse 17.

decisions.choice: the obedience of the one: Christ's whole obedience, completed in his death
decisions.reason: Christ's obedience is his obedience to the Father, "to the point of death, even death on a cross" (Philippians 2:8). It reverses Adam's disobedience.

decisions.choice: the disobedience of one man made the many sinners
alternatives: the many were made sinners through the disobedience of one man
decisions.reason: Balanced turns the passive verbs into active ones, with disobedience and obedience as subjects.

decisions.choice: constituted (L); became, will be made (R)
decisions.reason: Literal uses "constituted" for the legal sense of the verb; Readable says it simply.

decisions.choice: quedaron establecidos; quedarán establecidos
decisions.reason: Literal says that the many were set in a standing, the sense the meaning decision gives, as the English Literal "constituted" does.

decisions.choice: waliwekwa kuwa; watawekwa kuwa
decisions.reason: "Kuwekwa kuwa" (to be appointed as) says that the many were set in a standing, the sense the meaning decision gives.

decisions.choice: "bị lập làm", "được lập làm" (L)
decisions.reason: The verb means to appoint or set in a standing (m1); "lập làm" is the Vietnamese for setting someone in a position, as in 1:4. Balanced and Readable say "trở thành", "được làm cho", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "세워지다" (L); "자리에 서게 하다" (B); "죄인이 되다 / 의로운 사람으로 인정받다" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb puts someone in a position, a standing before God (meaning decision). "만들다" (make) would suggest a change of character, so Literal says "세워지다" and Balanced "자리에 서게 하다"; Readable says the righteous standing with "인정받다", the word of God's verdict.

source.text: νόμος δὲ παρεισῆλθεν ἵνα πλεονάσῃ τὸ παράπτωμα· οὗ δὲ ἐπλεόνασεν ἡ ἁμαρτία, ὑπερεπερίσσευσεν ἡ χάρις, ἵνα ὥσπερ ἐβασίλευσεν ἡ ἁμαρτία ἐν τῷ θανάτῳ, οὕτως καὶ ἡ χάρις βασιλεύσῃ διὰ δικαιοσύνης εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Law and came in alongside so that might increase the trespass; where but increased the sin, overflowed beyond the grace, \v 21 so that just as reigned the sin in the death, so also the grace might reign through righteousness to life eternal through Jesus Christ the Lord of us.

en.L: And [the] law came in alongside so that the trespass might increase; but where sin increased, grace overflowed all the more, \v 21 so that, just as sin reigned in death, grace also might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} our Lord.
en.B: The law came in alongside, so that the trespass would multiply. But where sin multiplied, grace overflowed far beyond it, \v 21 so that, as sin held its reign through death, grace in turn might reign through righteousness and lead to eternal life through Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} our Lord.
en.R: Then the law came in, so that wrongdoing would grow even more. But where sin grew, God's grace grew far more. \v 21 Sin ruled over people and brought them death. Now God's grace rules instead, through the righteousness God gives, and it leads to eternal life through Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} our Lord.

es.L: Y [la] ley entró además para que la transgresión se multiplicara; pero donde se multiplicó el pecado, la gracia desbordó todavía más, \v 21 a fin de que, tal como el pecado reinó en la muerte, también la gracia reinara por medio de [la] justicia hacia vida eterna por medio de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} nuestro Señor.
es.B: La ley vino a añadirse, para que la transgresión se multiplicara. Pero donde se multiplicó el pecado, la gracia se desbordó mucho más allá, \v 21 para que, así como el pecado ejerció su reinado por medio de la muerte, la gracia a su vez reinara por medio de la justicia y llevara a la vida eterna por medio de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} nuestro Señor.
es.R: Después vino la ley, para que el mal que se hacía creciera todavía más. Pero donde creció el pecado, la gracia de Dios creció mucho más. \v 21 El pecado gobernaba sobre las personas y les traía la muerte. Ahora, en cambio, gobierna la gracia de Dios, por medio de la justicia que Dios da, y lleva a la vida eterna por medio de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} nuestro Señor.

sw.L: Na sheria iliingia kama nyongeza ili kosa lipate kuongezeka; lakini dhambi ilipoongezeka, neema ilifurika zaidi sana, \v 21 ili kwamba, jinsi dhambi ilivyotawala katika kifo, ndivyo neema pia ipate kutawala kupitia haki hadi uzima wa milele kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Bwana wetu.
sw.B: Sheria ilikuja kama nyongeza, ili kosa liongezeke. Lakini dhambi ilipoongezeka, neema ilifurika kupita kiasi, \v 21 ili, kama dhambi ilivyoshika utawala wake kupitia kifo, neema nayo itawale kupitia haki na kuongoza hadi uzima wa milele kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Bwana wetu.
sw.R: Kisha sheria ikaja, ili makosa yaongezeke zaidi. Lakini pale dhambi ilipoongezeka, neema ya Mungu iliongezeka zaidi sana. \v 21 Dhambi ilitawala juu ya watu na kuwaletea kifo. Sasa neema ya Mungu inatawala badala yake, kupitia haki ambayo Mungu anatoa, nayo inaongoza hadi uzima wa milele kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Bwana wetu.

fr.L: Or [la] Loi est venue s’ajouter pour que la faute se multiplie ; mais là où le péché s’est multiplié, la grâce a surabondé, \v 21 afin que, comme le péché a régné dans la mort, ainsi la grâce aussi règne par [la] justice pour la vie éternelle par Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}} notre Seigneur.
fr.B: La Loi est venue s’ajouter, pour que la faute se multiplie. Mais là où le péché s’est multiplié, la grâce a débordé bien au-delà, \v 21 afin que, comme le péché a exercé son règne par la mort, la grâce à son tour règne par la justice et conduise à la vie éternelle par Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, notre Seigneur.
fr.R: Puis la Loi est venue, pour que le mal grandisse encore plus. Mais là où le péché a grandi, la grâce de Dieu a grandi bien davantage. \v 21 Le péché régnait sur les gens et leur apportait la mort. Maintenant, c’est la grâce de Dieu qui règne à sa place, par la justice que Dieu donne, et elle conduit à la vie éternelle par Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, notre Seigneur.

vi.L: Và luật pháp đã xen vào để sự vi phạm gia tăng; nhưng nơi nào tội lỗi gia tăng, thì ân điển càng dư dật hơn nữa, \v 21 để như tội lỗi đã cai trị trong sự chết thể nào, thì ân điển cũng cai trị bởi sự công chính để [đem đến] sự sống đời đời qua Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, Chúa chúng ta.
vi.B: Luật pháp đã xen vào để sự vi phạm thêm nhiều. Nhưng nơi nào tội lỗi thêm nhiều, thì ân điển càng tuôn tràn vượt bội hơn, \v 21 để như tội lỗi đã cai trị qua sự chết, thì ân điển cũng cai trị qua sự công chính và dẫn đến sự sống đời đời qua Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, Chúa chúng ta.
vi.R: Rồi luật pháp đến, khiến cho những điều sai trái càng thêm nhiều. Nhưng nơi nào tội lỗi gia tăng, thì ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời còn gia tăng nhiều hơn nữa. \v 21 Tội lỗi đã cai trị con người và đem họ đến sự chết. Bây giờ ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời cai trị thay thế, qua sự công chính mà Đức Chúa Trời ban cho, và dẫn đến sự sống đời đời qua Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, Chúa chúng ta.

ko.L: 율법이 곁에 들어온 것은 범죄가 많아지게 하려는 것이었습니다. 그러나 죄가 많아진 곳에 은혜가 넘치고도 넘쳤습니다. \v 21 이는 죄가 죽음 안에서 왕 노릇 한 것처럼, 은혜도 의를 통하여 왕 노릇 하여, 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통하여 영원한 생명에 이르게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 율법이 덧붙여 들어온 것은 범죄가 늘어나게 하려는 것이었습니다. 그러나 죄가 늘어난 곳에 은혜는 훨씬 더 넘쳤습니다. \v 21 그것은 죄가 죽음으로 왕처럼 다스렸듯이, 은혜도 의를 통해 왕처럼 다스려, 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통해 영원한 생명에 이르게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.R: 그 후에 율법이 들어왔습니다. 잘못이 더 늘어나게 하려는 것이었습니다. 그러나 죄가 늘어난 곳에, 하나님의 은혜는 훨씬 더 넘쳤습니다. \v 21 죄는 사람들을 다스리면서 그들에게 죽음을 가져왔습니다. 이제는 하나님의 은혜가 대신 다스립니다. 하나님께서 주시는 의를 통해 다스리고, 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통해 영원한 생명으로 이끕니다.

decisions.choice: came in alongside: added to a situation already there
decisions.reason: pareiserchomai is to come in beside. The law of Moses came in after sin and death were already in the world (verses 13-14), as Galatians 3:19 says it "was added". It does not here mean coming in secretly.

decisions.choice: so that the trespass might increase: the law's purpose in God's plan
alternatives: with the result that the trespass increased
decisions.reason: hina most naturally gives purpose: the law made sin into open transgression of a command and so made it more and plainer (4:15, 7:7-13, Galatians 3:19). Some read it as result only.

decisions.choice: overflowed all the more: grace far beyond sin
decisions.reason: Paul adds a prefix to the verb "overflow" of verse 15 to make it stronger: grace overflowed beyond all measure.

decisions.choice: reigned in death: ruled by means of death
alternatives: sin reigned in the realm of death
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean sin ruled with death as its power and its result, or ruled in the realm of death. Grace, in contrast, rules "through righteousness" and leads to life.

decisions.choice: through righteousness: the righteousness God gives
decisions.reason: As in verse 17, righteousness is God's gift of right standing, and with it the righteous life it brings (chapter 6).

decisions.choice: multiply
decisions.reason: The same verb comes twice; Balanced keeps one word for both, so the reader sees grace answering sin.

decisions.choice: wrongdoing
decisions.reason: Readable uses an everyday word for "trespass", as for "sin" in verse 15.

decisions.choice: the righteousness God gives
decisions.reason: Readable says what the righteousness is, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: entró además (L); vino a añadirse (B)
decisions.reason: Says what the meaning decision describes: the law was added to a situation already there.

decisions.choice: iliingia kama nyongeza (L); ilikuja kama nyongeza (B)
decisions.reason: "Kama nyongeza" (as an addition) says what the meaning decision describes: the law was added to a situation already there.

decisions.choice: "a surabondé"
decisions.reason: Paul adds a prefix to the verb "abonder" of verse 15; French "surabonder" does the same with one word. Balanced and Readable say it in ordinary words.

decisions.choice: "đã xen vào" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The verb is "came in alongside": the law was added to a situation already there (m1). "Xen vào" says that it came in between what was already in place. Readable says plainly that it came.

decisions.choice: "넘치고도 넘쳤습니다" (L); "훨씬 더 넘쳤습니다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Paul adds a prefix to the verb "overflow" of verse 15 (meaning decision). Literal doubles the Korean verb to give the same force; Balanced and Readable say it in ordinary words. "많아지다" (L) and "늘어나다" (B, R) are each kept for both uses of the other verb, so grace is seen answering sin.
